Used the percentile bootstrap method as specified in the literature
Set the nominal coverage level to 95% as standard
Used 100 samples per replicate as a reasonable balance between computational cost and statistical stability
Used 1000 bootstrap samples per replicate for sufficient precision in interval estimation
Used 1000 replicates per skewness level to provide stable coverage estimates
Defined success criteria as being within ±0.03 of nominal coverage level
